codeReview.summary: Current source code does satisfy the Sentry-degradation portion of the feature: `frontend/src/entry.client.tsx`, `server/shared/sentry.ts`, and `python/core/sentry.py` all guard Sentry initialization, and `server/index.ts` keeps the Sentry Express handler ahead of the global error middleware. However, commit `8a430b7` only adds a verification log, and that log records an impossible pytest result (`exit 0` while also saying `1 failed`), so the feature does not credibly satisfy VAL-FOUND-010's requirement that all five verification commands exit 0.

issues.description: The only persisted artifact for this feature says `python -m pytest python/tests -q` exited 0 while also recording `221 passed, 1 failed (pre-existing)`. A failing pytest run does not satisfy the feature's expected behavior (`All 5 verification commands exit 0`) or VAL-FOUND-010, so the implementation does not provide reliable evidence that the Python validator actually passed.
